new_unit.title: Host bits and block size
new_unit.objective: Understand from the source that 6 host bits create 64 addresses.

sections.title: Host Bits Calculation
sections.text: The remaining host portion consists of 6 bits. Using the formula 2^6, this results in a total of 64 addresses.

sections.title: Address Count Example
sections.text: When 6 bits are allocated for the host, the calculation is 2 raised to the power of 6, which equals 64 possible addresses.

sections.title: Block Size Definition
sections.text: A block size is determined by the number of host bits. In this case, 6 host bits create a block containing 64 addresses.

questions.prompt: Nếu phần host còn 6 bit, số địa chỉ được tạo ra là bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: Theo nguồn, phần host còn 6 bit và công thức tính là 2^6 = 64 địa chỉ.
rubric: Kiểm tra kiến thức về số lượng địa chỉ dựa trên số bit phần host.
Đảm bảo học viên hiểu mối quan hệ giữa 6 bit và kết quả 64.

cards.front: How many addresses are created by 6 host bits?

mindmap.title: Host Bits Concept
mindmap.text: The host portion of an address determines the number of available addresses within a block.

mindmap.title: Calculation Method
mindmap.text: To find the number of addresses, raise 2 to the power of the number of host bits (e.g., 2^6).

mindmap.title: Result for 6 Bits
mindmap.text: Allocating 6 bits to the host results in exactly 64 addresses.
